dependency51.lit.source:
have points set = cart(R, R)

have fn vec(A, B cart(R, R)) cart(R, R) = (B(1) - A(1), B(2) - A(2))

have fn dot(u, v cart(R, R)) R = u(1) * v(1) + u(2) * v(2)

have fn det(u, v cart(R, R)) R = u(1) * v(2) - u(2) * v(1)

have fn distance_sq(a, b cart(R, R)) R = dot(vec(a, b), vec(a, b))

have fn line(a, b, c R: a != 0 or b != 0) power_set(cart(R, R)) = {p cart(R, R): a * p(1) + b * p(2) + c = 0}

have fn line_through_points(a, b cart(R, R): a != b) power_set(cart(R, R)) = {p cart(R, R): det(vec(a, p), vec(a, b)) = 0}

have fn angle_cos_num(p, q, r cart(R, R): p != q, r != q) R = dot(vec(q, p), vec(q, r))

have fn angle_cos_den(p, q, r cart(R, R): p != q, r != q) R = distance_sq(q, p) * distance_sq(q, r)

have fn circle(o cart(R, R), r R+) power_set(cart(R, R)) = {p cart(R, R): distance_sq(o, p) = r * r}

prop is_on_segment(p, a, b cart(R, R)):
    a != b
    exist t R st {0 <= t, t <= 1, p(1) = (1 - t) * a(1) + t * b(1), p(2) = (1 - t) * a(2) + t * b(2)}

prop is_on_ray(p, a, b cart(R, R)):
    a != b
    exist t R st {0 <= t, p(1) = a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1)), p(2) = a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))}

prop is_collinear(p, q, r cart(R, R)):
    det(vec(p, q), vec(p, r)) = 0

prop are_segments_congruent(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    distance_sq(a, b) = distance_sq(c, d)

prop are_angles_congruent(p, q, r, u, v, w cart(R, R)):
    p != q
    r != q
    u != v
    w != v
    angle_cos_den(p, q, r) > 0
    angle_cos_den(u, v, w) > 0
    angle_cos_num(p, q, r)^2 * angle_cos_den(u, v, w) = angle_cos_num(u, v, w)^2 * angle_cos_den(p, q, r)
    angle_cos_num(p, q, r) * angle_cos_num(u, v, w) >= 0

prop is_right_angle(p, q, r cart(R, R)):
    p != q
    r != q
    dot(vec(q, p), vec(q, r)) = 0

prop is_parallel(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    a != b
    c != d
    det(vec(a, b), vec(c, d)) = 0

prop is_perpendicular(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    a != b
    c != d
    dot(vec(a, b), vec(c, d)) = 0

prop is_line(l power_set(cart(R, R))):
    exist a, b, c R st {a != 0 or b != 0, l = line(a, b, c)}

prop is_midpoint(m, a, b cart(R, R)):
    m(1) = (a(1) + b(1)) / 2
    m(2) = (a(2) + b(2)) / 2

prop is_affine_combination(p, a, b cart(R, R)):
    exist t R st {p(1) = (1 - t) * a(1) + t * b(1), p(2) = (1 - t) * a(2) + t * b(2)}

prop is_centroid(g, a, b, c cart(R, R)):
    g(1) = (a(1) + b(1) + c(1)) / 3
    g(2) = (a(2) + b(2) + c(2)) / 3

prop is_on_line(p, a, b cart(R, R)):
    a != b
    p $in line_through_points(a, b)

prop is_on_extension(p, a, b cart(R, R)):
    a != b
    exist t R st {t > 1, p(1) = (1 - t) * a(1) + t * b(1), p(2) = (1 - t) * a(2) + t * b(2)}

prop is_foot(f, p, a, b cart(R, R)):
    $is_on_line(f, a, b)
    dot(vec(p, f), vec(a, b)) = 0

prop is_angle_bisector(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    $are_angles_congruent(a, b, d, d, b, c)

prop is_triangle(a, b, c cart(R, R)):
    det(vec(a, b), vec(a, c)) != 0

prop is_isosceles(a, b, c cart(R, R)):
    $is_triangle(a, b, c)
    $are_segments_congruent(a, b, a, c)

prop is_equilateral(a, b, c cart(R, R)):
    $is_triangle(a, b, c)
    $are_segments_congruent(a, b, b, c)
    $are_segments_congruent(b, c, c, a)

prop are_triangles_congruent(p, q, r, u, v, w cart(R, R)):
    $is_triangle(p, q, r)
    $is_triangle(u, v, w)
    $are_segments_congruent(p, q, u, v)
    $are_segments_congruent(q, r, v, w)
    $are_segments_congruent(r, p, w, u)

prop are_triangles_similar(p, q, r, u, v, w cart(R, R)):
    $is_triangle(p, q, r)
    $is_triangle(u, v, w)
    $are_angles_congruent(q, p, r, v, u, w)
    $are_angles_congruent(p, q, r, u, v, w)
    $are_angles_congruent(p, r, q, u, w, v)

prop is_parallelogram(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    $is_parallel(a, b, d, c)
    $is_parallel(a, d, b, c)

prop is_rectangle(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    $is_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
    $is_right_angle(d, a, b)

prop is_rhombus(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    $is_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
    $are_segments_congruent(a, b, b, c)

prop is_square(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    $is_rectangle(a, b, c, d)
    $are_segments_congruent(a, b, b, c)

prop is_on_circle(p, o cart(R, R), r R+):
    distance_sq(o, p) = r * r

prop are_concyclic(a, b, c, d cart(R, R)):
    exist o cart(R, R) st {distance_sq(o, a) = distance_sq(o, b), distance_sq(o, b) = distance_sq(o, c), distance_sq(o, c) = distance_sq(o, d)}

prop is_diameter_endpoints(a, b, o cart(R, R)):
    a != b
    $is_midpoint(o, a, b)

prop rotated_90_cw(q, p, c cart(R, R)):
    q(1) = c(1) + p(2) - c(2)
    q(2) = c(2) - p(1) + c(1)

prop rotated_90_ccw(q, p, c cart(R, R)):
    q(1) = c(1) - p(2) + c(2)
    q(2) = c(2) + p(1) - c(1)

thm distance_sq_coordinate_formula:
    ? forall a, b cart(R, R):
        distance_sq(a, b) = (b(1) - a(1))^2 + (b(2) - a(2))^2
    vec(a, b)(1) = b(1) - a(1)
    vec(a, b)(2) = b(2) - a(2)
    distance_sq(a, b) = dot(vec(a, b), vec(a, b))
    dot(vec(a, b), vec(a, b)) = vec(a, b)(1) * vec(a, b)(1) + vec(a, b)(2) * vec(a, b)(2) = (b(1) - a(1)) * (b(1) - a(1)) + (b(2) - a(2)) * (b(2) - a(2)) = (b(1) - a(1))^2 + (b(2) - a(2))^2

thm distance_sq_nonnegative:
    ? forall a, b cart(R, R):
        0 <= distance_sq(a, b)
    release thm distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a,b)
    0 <= (b(1)-a(1))^2
    0 <= (b(2)-a(2))^2
    0 <= (b(1)-a(1))^2 + (b(2)-a(2))^2

thm distance_sq_symmetric:
    ? forall a, b cart(R, R):
        distance_sq(a, b) = distance_sq(b, a)
    release thm distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a,b)
    release thm distance_sq_coordinate_formula(b,a)
    (b(1)-a(1))^2 + (b(2)-a(2))^2 = (a(1)-b(1))^2 + (a(2)-b(2))^2

thm perpendicular_dot_expand:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
        dot(vec(a, b), vec(c, d)) = (b(1) - a(1)) * (d(1) - c(1)) + (b(2) - a(2)) * (d(2) - c(2))
    vec(a,b)(1) = b(1)-a(1)
    vec(a,b)(2) = b(2)-a(2)
    vec(c,d)(1) = d(1)-c(1)
    vec(c,d)(2) = d(2)-c(2)
    dot(vec(a, b), vec(c, d)) = vec(a, b)(1) * vec(c, d)(1) + vec(a, b)(2) * vec(c, d)(2) = (b(1) - a(1)) * (d(1) - c(1)) + (b(2) - a(2)) * (d(2) - c(2))

thm distance_sq_positive_of_ne:
    ? forall a, b cart(R, R):
        a != b
        =>:
            0 < distance_sq(a, b)
    by contra:
        ? 0 < distance_sq(a, b)
        distance_sq(a, b) <= 0
        release thm distance_sq_nonnegative(a, b)
        distance_sq(a, b) = 0
        release thm distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, b)
        (b(1) - a(1))^2 + (b(2) - a(2))^2 = 0
        0 <= (b(1) - a(1))^2
        0 <= (b(2) - a(2))^2
        (b(1) - a(1))^2 <= (b(1) - a(1))^2 + (b(2) - a(2))^2 = 0
        (b(2) - a(2))^2 <= (b(1) - a(1))^2 + (b(2) - a(2))^2 = 0
        (b(1) - a(1))^2 = 0
        (b(2) - a(2))^2 = 0
        b(1) - a(1) = 0
        b(2) - a(2) = 0
        a(1) = b(1)
        a(2) = b(2)
        a = (a(1), a(2))
        b = (b(1), b(2))
        (a(1), a(2)) = (b(1), b(2))
        a = (a(1), a(2)) = (b(1), b(2)) = b
        a = b
        impossible a != b

thm affine_combination_distance_sq:
    ? forall a, b, p cart(R, R), t R:
        p(1) = (1 - t) * a(1) + t * b(1)
        p(2) = (1 - t) * a(2) + t * b(2)
        =>:
            distance_sq(a, p) = t^2 * distance_sq(a, b)
    release thm distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, p)
    release thm distance_sq_coordinate_formula(a, b)
    distance_sq(a, p) = (p(1) - a(1))^2 + (p(2) - a(2))^2
    (p(1) - a(1))^2 + (p(2) - a(2))^2 = ((1 - t) * a(1) + t * b(1) - a(1))^2 + ((1 - t) * a(2) + t * b(2) - a(2))^2
    ((1 - t) * a(1) + t * b(1) - a(1))^2 + ((1 - t) * a(2) + t * b(2) - a(2))^2 = t^2 * ((b(1) - a(1))^2 + (b(2) - a(2))^2)
    t^2 * ((b(1) - a(1))^2 + (b(2) - a(2))^2) = t^2 * distance_sq(a, b)
    distance_sq(a, p) = t^2 * distance_sq(a, b)

thm vertical_angles_square_core:
    ? forall t, s, x, y, z R:
        =>:
            (t * s * x)^2 * ((1 - t)^2 * y * (1 - s)^2 * z) = ((1 - t) * (1 - s) * x)^2 * (t^2 * y * s^2 * z)

thm vertical_angles_sign_core:
    ? forall t, s, x R:
        0 <= t
        t <= 1
        0 <= s
        s <= 1
        =>:
            (t * s * x) * ((1 - t) * (1 - s) * x) >= 0
    t * s >= 0
    1 - t >= 0
    1 - s >= 0
    (1 - t) * (1 - s) >= 0
    t*s*(1-t) >= 0
    t * s * (1 - t) * (1 - s) >= 0
    x^2 >= 0
    t * s * (1 - t) * (1 - s) * x^2 >= 0
    (t * s * x) * ((1 - t) * (1 - s) * x) = t * s * (1 - t) * (1 - s) * x^2 >= 0

thm affine_dot_backward:
    ? forall a, b, c, d, o cart(R, R), t, s R:
        o(1) = a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))
        o(2) = a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))
        o(1) = c(1) + s * (d(1) - c(1))
        o(2) = c(2) + s * (d(2) - c(2))
        =>:
            (a(1) - o(1)) * (c(1) - o(1)) + (a(2) - o(2)) * (c(2) - o(2)) = t * s * ((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(1) - c(1)) + (b(2) - a(2)) * (d(2) - c(2)))
    a(1) - o(1) = a(1) - (a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))) = -t * (b(1) - a(1))
    a(2) - o(2) = a(2) - (a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))) = -t * (b(2) - a(2))
    c(1) - o(1) = c(1) - (c(1) + s * (d(1) - c(1))) = -s * (d(1) - c(1))
    c(2) - o(2) = c(2) - (c(2) + s * (d(2) - c(2))) = -s * (d(2) - c(2))
    (a(1) - o(1)) * (c(1) - o(1)) + (a(2) - o(2)) * (c(2) - o(2)) = (-t * (b(1) - a(1))) * (-s * (d(1) - c(1))) + (-t * (b(2) - a(2))) * (-s * (d(2) - c(2))) = t * s * ((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(1) - c(1)) + (b(2) - a(2)) * (d(2) - c(2)))

thm affine_dot_forward:
    ? forall a, b, c, d, o cart(R, R), t, s R:
        o(1) = a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))
        o(2) = a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))
        o(1) = c(1) + s * (d(1) - c(1))
        o(2) = c(2) + s * (d(2) - c(2))
        =>:
            (b(1) - o(1)) * (d(1) - o(1)) + (b(2) - o(2)) * (d(2) - o(2)) = (1 - t) * (1 - s) * ((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(1) - c(1)) + (b(2) - a(2)) * (d(2) - c(2)))
    b(1) - o(1) = b(1) - (a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))) = (1 - t) * (b(1) - a(1))
    b(2) - o(2) = b(2) - (a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))) = (1 - t) * (b(2) - a(2))
    d(1) - o(1) = d(1) - (c(1) + s * (d(1) - c(1))) = (1 - s) * (d(1) - c(1))
    d(2) - o(2) = d(2) - (c(2) + s * (d(2) - c(2))) = (1 - s) * (d(2) - c(2))
    (b(1) - o(1)) * (d(1) - o(1)) + (b(2) - o(2)) * (d(2) - o(2)) = ((1 - t) * (b(1) - a(1))) * ((1 - s) * (d(1) - c(1))) + ((1 - t) * (b(2) - a(2))) * ((1 - s) * (d(2) - c(2))) = (1 - t) * (1 - s) * ((b(1) - a(1)) * (d(1) - c(1)) + (b(2) - a(2)) * (d(2) - c(2)))

thm affine_distance_from_parameter:
    ? forall a, b, o cart(R, R), t R:
        o(1) = a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1))
        o(2) = a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2))
        =>:
            distance_sq(o, a) = t^2 * distance_sq(a, b)
            distance_sq(o, b) = (1 - t)^2 * distance_sq(a, b)
    a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1)) = (1 - t) * a(1) + t * b(1)
    o(1) = (1 - t) * a(1) + t * b(1)
    a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2)) = (1 - t) * a(2) + t * b(2)
    o(2) = (1 - t) * a(2) + t * b(2)
    a(1) + t * (b(1) - a(1)) = (1 - (1 - t)) * b(1) + (1 - t) * a(1)
    o(1) = (1 - (1 - t)) * b(1) + (1 - t) * a(1)
    a(2) + t * (b(2) - a(2)) = (1 - (1 - t)) * b(2) + (1 - t) * a(2)
    o(2) = (1 - (1 - t)) * b(2) + (1 - t) * a(2)
    release thm affine_combination_distance_sq(a, b, o, t)
    release thm affine_combination_distance_sq(b, a, o, 1 - t)
    release thm distance_sq_symmetric(o, a)
    release thm distance_sq_symmetric(o, b)
    release thm distance_sq_symmetric(a, b)
    distance_sq(o, a) = distance_sq(a, o)
    distance_sq(a, o) = t^2 * distance_sq(a, b)
    distance_sq(o, a) = t^2 * distance_sq(a, b)
    distance_sq(o, b) = distance_sq(b, o)
    distance_sq(b, o) = (1 - t)^2 * distance_sq(b, a)
    distance_sq(b, a) = distance_sq(a, b)
    (1 - t)^2 * distance_sq(b, a) = (1 - t)^2 * distance_sq(a, b)
    distance_sq(o, b) = (1 - t)^2 * distance_sq(a, b)

sketch:
    thm vertical_scalar_measure_relations:
        ? forall weight_t, weight_s, raw_dot, squared_ab, squared_cd, num_left, num_right, den_left, den_right R:
            0 <= weight_t
            weight_t <= 1
            0 <= weight_s
            weight_s <= 1
            num_left = weight_t*weight_s*raw_dot
            num_right = (1-weight_t)*(1-weight_s)*raw_dot
            den_left = weight_t^2*squared_ab*weight_s^2*squared_cd
            den_right = (1-weight_t)^2*squared_ab*(1-weight_s)^2*squared_cd
            =>:
                num_left^2*den_right = num_right^2*den_left
                num_left*num_right >= 0
        num_left^2 = (weight_t*weight_s*raw_dot)^2
        num_right^2 = ((1-weight_t)*(1-weight_s)*raw_dot)^2
        release thm vertical_angles_square_core(weight_t,weight_s,raw_dot,squared_ab,squared_cd)
        num_left^2*den_right = (weight_t*weight_s*raw_dot)^2*((1-weight_t)^2*squared_ab*(1-weight_s)^2*squared_cd) = ((1-weight_t)*(1-weight_s)*raw_dot)^2*(weight_t^2*squared_ab*weight_s^2*squared_cd) = num_right^2*den_left
        release thm vertical_angles_sign_core(weight_t,weight_s,raw_dot)
        num_left*num_right = (weight_t*weight_s*raw_dot)*((1-weight_t)*(1-weight_s)*raw_dot) >= 0

cost35.lit.source:
sketch:
    claim:
        ? forall a, b, c, d, o cart(R, R):
            a != b
            c != d
            $is_on_segment(o, a, b)
            a != o
            b != o
            $is_on_segment(o, c, d)
            c != o
            d != o
            =>:
                0=0
        by def $is_on_segment(o, a, b)
        obtain t from exist t0 R st {0 <= t0, t0 <= 1, o(1) = (1-t0)*a(1)+t0*b(1), o(2) = (1-t0)*a(2)+t0*b(2)}
        by def $is_on_segment(o, c, d)
        obtain s from exist s0 R st {0 <= s0, s0 <= 1, o(1) = (1-s0)*c(1)+s0*d(1), o(2) = (1-s0)*c(2)+s0*d(2)}
        o(1) = (1-t)*a(1)+t*b(1) = a(1)+t*(b(1)-a(1))
        o(2) = (1-t)*a(2)+t*b(2) = a(2)+t*(b(2)-a(2))
        o(1) = (1-s)*c(1)+s*d(1) = c(1)+s*(d(1)-c(1))
        o(2) = (1-s)*c(2)+s*d(2) = c(2)+s*(d(2)-c(2))
        have x R = dot(vec(a,b),vec(c,d))
        have y R = distance_sq(a,b)
        have z R = distance_sq(c,d)
        have numerator_left R = angle_cos_num(a,o,c)
        have numerator_right R = angle_cos_num(b,o,d)
        have denominator_left R = angle_cos_den(a,o,c)
        have denominator_right R = angle_cos_den(b,o,d)
        release thm perpendicular_dot_expand(a,b,c,d)
        x = ((b(1)-a(1))*(d(1)-c(1))+(b(2)-a(2))*(d(2)-c(2)))
        release thm affine_dot_backward(a,b,c,d,o,t,s)
        release thm affine_dot_forward(a,b,c,d,o,t,s)
        release thm perpendicular_dot_expand(o,a,o,c)
        release thm perpendicular_dot_expand(o,b,o,d)
        angle_cos_num(a,o,c) = dot(vec(o,a),vec(o,c))
        numerator_left = angle_cos_num(a,o,c) = dot(vec(o,a),vec(o,c)) = ((a(1)-o(1))*(c(1)-o(1))+(a(2)-o(2))*(c(2)-o(2))) = t*s*((b(1)-a(1))*(d(1)-c(1))+(b(2)-a(2))*(d(2)-c(2))) = t*s*x
        angle_cos_num(b,o,d) = dot(vec(o,b),vec(o,d))
        numerator_right = angle_cos_num(b,o,d) = dot(vec(o,b),vec(o,d)) = ((b(1)-o(1))*(d(1)-o(1))+(b(2)-o(2))*(d(2)-o(2))) = (1-t)*(1-s)*((b(1)-a(1))*(d(1)-c(1))+(b(2)-a(2))*(d(2)-c(2))) = (1-t)*(1-s)*x
        release thm affine_distance_from_parameter(a,b,o,t)

sketch:
    thm vertical_angles_equal:
        ? forall a, b, c, d, o cart(R, R):
            a != b
            c != d
            $is_on_segment(o, a, b)
            a != o
            b != o
            $is_on_segment(o, c, d)
            c != o
            d != o
            =>:
                $are_angles_congruent(a, o, c, b, o, d)
        thm vertical_scalar_measure_relations:
            ? forall weight_t, weight_s, raw_dot, squared_ab, squared_cd, num_left, num_right, den_left, den_right R:
                0 <= weight_t
                weight_t <= 1
                0 <= weight_s
                weight_s <= 1
                num_left = weight_t*weight_s*raw_dot
                num_right = (1-weight_t)*(1-weight_s)*raw_dot
                den_left = weight_t^2*squared_ab*weight_s^2*squared_cd
                den_right = (1-weight_t)^2*squared_ab*(1-weight_s)^2*squared_cd
                =>:
                    num_left^2*den_right = num_right^2*den_left
                    num_left*num_right >= 0
            num_left^2 = (weight_t*weight_s*raw_dot)^2
            num_right^2 = ((1-weight_t)*(1-weight_s)*raw_dot)^2
            release thm vertical_angles_square_core(weight_t,weight_s,raw_dot,squared_ab,squared_cd)
            num_left^2*den_right = (weight_t*weight_s*raw_dot)^2*((1-weight_t)^2*squared_ab*(1-weight_s)^2*squared_cd) = ((1-weight_t)*(1-weight_s)*raw_dot)^2*(weight_t^2*squared_ab*weight_s^2*squared_cd) = num_right^2*den_left
            release thm vertical_angles_sign_core(weight_t,weight_s,raw_dot)
            num_left*num_right = (weight_t*weight_s*raw_dot)*((1-weight_t)*(1-weight_s)*raw_dot) >= 0
        by def $is_on_segment(o, a, b)
        obtain t from exist t0 R st {0 <= t0, t0 <= 1, o(1) = (1-t0)*a(1)+t0*b(1), o(2) = (1-t0)*a(2)+t0*b(2)}
        by def $is_on_segment(o, c, d)
        obtain s from exist s0 R st {0 <= s0, s0 <= 1, o(1) = (1-s0)*c(1)+s0*d(1), o(2) = (1-s0)*c(2)+s0*d(2)}
        o(1) = (1-t)*a(1)+t*b(1) = a(1)+t*(b(1)-a(1))
        o(2) = (1-t)*a(2)+t*b(2) = a(2)+t*(b(2)-a(2))
        o(1) = (1-s)*c(1)+s*d(1) = c(1)+s*(d(1)-c(1))
        o(2) = (1-s)*c(2)+s*d(2) = c(2)+s*(d(2)-c(2))
        have x R = dot(vec(a,b),vec(c,d))

        release thm perpendicular_dot_expand(a,b,c,d)

        release thm affine_dot_backward(a,b,c,d,o,t,s)
        release thm affine_dot_forward(a,b,c,d,o,t,s)
        release thm perpendicular_dot_expand(o,a,o,c)
        release thm perpendicular_dot_expand(o,b,o,d)
        angle_cos_num(a,o,c) = dot(vec(o,a),vec(o,c))

        angle_cos_num(b,o,d) = dot(vec(o,b),vec(o,d))
        angle_cos_num(b,o,d) = dot(vec(o,b),vec(o,d)) = ((b(1)-o(1))*(d(1)-o(1))+(b(2)-o(2))*(d(2)-o(2))) = (1-t)*(1-s)*((b(1)-a(1))*(d(1)-c(1))+(b(2)-a(2))*(d(2)-c(2))) = (1-t)*(1-s)*x
        release thm affine_distance_from_parameter(a,b,o,t)
        release thm affine_distance_from_parameter(c,d,o,s)
        distance_sq(o,a) = t^2*distance_sq(a,b) = t^2*y
        distance_sq(o,b) = (1-t)^2*distance_sq(a,b) = (1-t)^2*y
        distance_sq(o,c) = s^2*distance_sq(c,d) = s^2*z
        distance_sq(o,d) = (1-s)^2*distance_sq(c,d) = (1-s)^2*z
        angle_cos_den(a,o,c) = distance_sq(o,a)*distance_sq(o,c)
        angle_cos_den(a,o,c) = distance_sq(o,a)*distance_sq(o,c) = (t^2*y)*(s^2*z) = t^2*y*s^2*z
        angle_cos_den(b,o,d) = distance_sq(o,b)*distance_sq(o,d)
        angle_cos_den(b,o,d) = distance_sq(o,b)*distance_sq(o,d) = ((1-t)^2*y)*((1-s)^2*z) = (1-t)^2*y*(1-s)^2*z
        release thm distance_sq_positive_of_ne(o,a)
        release thm distance_sq_positive_of_ne(o,b)
        release thm distance_sq_positive_of_ne(o,c)
        release thm distance_sq_positive_of_ne(o,d)
        angle_cos_den(a,o,c) = distance_sq(o,a)*distance_sq(o,c) > 0
        angle_cos_den(b,o,d) = distance_sq(o,b)*distance_sq(o,d) > 0
        release thm vertical_scalar_measure_relations(t,s,x,y,z,angle_cos_num(a,o,c),angle_cos_num(b,o,d),angle_cos_den(a,o,c),angle_cos_den(b,o,d))
        by def $are_angles_congruent(a,o,c,b,o,d)
